data.statement: The shark mug earns its clean Arm A stop through source-faithful shape and contrast: a bright coastal breakfast lets the red tooth-lined drinking rim and projecting gray shark face emerge on the second look without requiring overlay text.
data.decision: Keep the coastal-breakfast artifact as this run's only survivor, reject the truthful but darker tide-pool still life and the ungenerated flat lay, and stop without a model revision.
data.nextAction: Prepare the exact unique Arm A afternoon package, record the standing bounded-experiment approval for that package, run validators and the guarded production dry run, then publish no more than one Pin in this run.
